subject: Stage-gate MAP & pricing ladder for AWS private offer (Acme AI)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@acme-ai.com>; Marcus Holden <marcus.holden@acme.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Stage-gate MAP & pricing ladder for AWS private offer (Acme AI)

Hi Priya / Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Per our conversation, I attached a stage-gate mutual action plan (MAP) that ties each evaluation milestone to a specific private-offer pricing tier and committed GPU months. The intention is to make the commercial path clear: smaller initial commit for POC, a ramp window tied to success criteria, and an end-state commit that unlocks the deepest unit pricing and SLA.

Key highlights in the attached MAP_Stage-Gate_v1.pdf and the pricing spreadsheet: 
- POC (2–4 weeks): 2 reserved GPU months —> trial private offer rate (20% off list).
- Ramp (90 days from POC sign): progressive commit to 6 reserved GPU months —> 30% off list + priority capacity.
- Production (annual): 12+ reserved GPU months —> 40% off list, dedicated pool and a 99.9% latency SLO.

For each gate we list acceptance criteria (evaluation prompt set pass-rate, latency SLOs on key routes, and cost per 1M tokens). If this looks reasonable we can convert to a draft AWS Private Offer and share a term sheet for procurement review.

Ask: can you confirm the procurement timeline and whether Acme would require an internal legal redline cycle before we send the PO draft? If helpful I can break the MAP into two tracks (tech and procurement) and own the procurement milestones with Lauren.

Attachments: MAP_Stage-Gate_v1.pdf (pdf), Commit_Tiers_and_Pricing.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference (www.redwood.com)
From: Priya Rao <priya@acme-ai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Holden <marcus.holden@acme.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP & pricing ladder for AWS private offer (Acme AI)

Ben —

Appreciate the clear layout. A few high-level questions from our side before we route to procurement: 
1) On the ramp cadence, can the mid-tier (6 months) be split across regions (us-west + us-east) without losing the tiered discount? We have a regional availability requirement for latency-sensitive customers.
2) Do the acceptance criteria include a precision/recall threshold for our internal evals? We typically need a minimum 93% pass on our prompt set for release to prod.
3) Procurement: we'll need an initial term sheet and a simple statement of work that references the MAP milestones. Our procurement lead (procurement@acme.com) will take over once we have the draft PO and pricing table.

We can do a 30-minute sync next Tuesday to walk through the MAP and the pricing ladder. Marcus — is 10am PT good for you?

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Rao | Head of Product "Generative" | Acme AI
priya@acme-ai.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Rao <priya@acme-ai.com>, Marcus Holden <marcus.holden@acme.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Sep 2025 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage-gate MAP & pricing ladder for AWS private offer (Acme AI)

Priya —

Answers inline: 
1) Regional split: yes — we can support a split pool (us-west + us-east) and count aggregate reserved GPU months toward the same discount tier as long as capacity reservation is in the same private-offer commitment. I will note that priority capacity guarantee applies per region; we can include a clause for cross-region failover in the term sheet.

2) Acceptance criteria: we included a generic pass-rate in the MAP. I'll update to explicitly require >=93% on Acme's canonical prompt set for POC to qualify to trigger the ramp gate. We'll add the eval harness link to the MAP doc.

3) Procurement: understood. I'll prepare a short term sheet and call out the DocuSign-ready private-offer draft once we align on the commit sizes.

Next steps: 30-min sync Tue 16 Sep at 10am PT (tentative). I've attached an updated pricing workbook with a two-region column and a simple term-sheet draft.

Attachments: Commit_Tiers_and_Pricing.xlsx (updated), Redwood_PrivateOffer_TermSheet_v2.docx

Best,
Ben

Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Stage-gate MAP & pricing ladder for AWS private offer (Acme AI)

Ben / Karthik —

Quick internal note on commercial levers we can offer without HQ sign-off: 
- We can push the mid-tier discount to 32% for a 6-month aggregate commit (up from 30%) if Acme signs within 30 days of POC acceptance. This is a limited, time-bound uplift tied to rapid ramp.
- For cross-region pools, priority capacity guarantees are best-effort unless the customer commits to the production (12-month) tier where we can reserve dedicated capacity per region.
- We should avoid making per-prompt SLA promises in the term sheet; link to the acceptance criteria and keep measurable gates to eval pass-rates and latency percentiles.

I'll stand by on the term-sheet language edits. Let me know if you want me to join the Tue sync.

—Priyom
Priom Das | Head, Solutions & Pricing | Redwood Inference

Priya / Marcus / Acme procurement —

Thanks for the sync two weeks ago. Per our agreements, attached is the final MAP (MAP_Stage-Gate_v1.pdf — updated with the 93% pass-rate and the two-region column), the pricing workbook with the 32% mid-tier uplift (Commit_Tiers_and_Pricing.xlsx), and a DocuSign-ready private-offer term sheet (Redwood_PrivateOffer_TermSheet_v2.docx).

Summary of milestones and commercial triggers: 
- POC sign (2 reserved GPU months): unlock trial private offer (20% off).
- Within 30 days of POC acceptance: ramp signature to 6 reserved GPU months -> 32% off (time-bound uplift).
- Annual commit (12+ months) within 120 days of ramp: 40% off + per-region reserved capacity and SLA addendum.

Action items for Acme procurement: 
1) Review term sheet and confirm legal redline windows by EOW 09/30.
2) If approved, we'll push the AWS Private Offer draft to your procurement mailbox and initiate DocuSign.

DocuSign link (draft): https://docusign.redwood.com/drafts/DW-ACME-2025-092 (expires 2025-10-15)
AWS PO preview: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/solutions/acme-private-offer-draft

If procurement wants a short call to walk the term sheet, I'm available Thu 09/25 9–11am PT.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Acme into POC.

Ben
Ben Carter | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
